title: P6.8-M ‘shabu’ seized, high-value suspect nabbed in Zamboanga City

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur—Police arrested a newly identified high-value drug suspect and confiscated approximately one kilogram of suspected “shabu” (crystal meth) valued at P6.8 million during a joint buy-bust operation here early Friday morning.
